origin_intent: Unified continuous factory / Gate != future project
invariant: A gate is an append-only proof point inside one durable mission. Passing a gate continues the same goal/work lineage; failing reopens only the smallest defective cell. No new scheduler, project, chat, or markdown handover is required.
observation: Live WorkGraph already has goal, goal_round, round_work, gate_decision, event and harness_capability. However gate_decision stores only work_id/gate/verdict/reason/evidence_event_id/decided_by, and the current uc_workgraph.py gate command has no explicit correlation_id, cell_id, capability_version or continuation route fields.
expected: Reuse the existing gate_decision + append-only event model so every continuous gate can carry correlation_id, cell_id, capability_id/version, evidence refs and route outcome (CONTINUE|WAIT|REOPEN|DONE) while preserving the same goal/work lineage. Prefer an enriched linked event over a second scheduler or database.
actual: Human/GitHub projections can express continuous gates, but a fresh runtime cannot reconstruct the full continuous-factory transition from gate_decision alone without consulting surrounding context.

allowed: extend existing WorkGraph gate event semantics additively
reuse gate_decision, event, goal/round and existing leases
add backward-compatible CLI metadata/options and tests
forbidden: create a second scheduler or second execution database
require ChatGPT session state or markdown handovers
turn each gate into a new GitHub project/issue by default

reply_contract: Return the exact append-only gate envelope/CLI contract, tests proving backward compatibility, one replayable gate chain on a shadow DB, and whether any additive migration was actually required.
